status: designed; not an executed LLM evaluation

cases.prompt: 我的英文综述题目是 AI Models for GPCR Pharmacology，目标是比较激动/拮抗预测和偏向性信号通路预测。请开始讨论。
expected: provides substantive domain critique
distinguishes binding, efficacy, pathway bias
asks at most one consequential clarification by default
does not draft manuscript
does not pretend user approved suggestions

cases.prompt: 我的DTI综述分类为Cross-Attention、Bilinear Attention、Contact Prediction、ESM模型。这样就可以作为并列章节吗？
expected: identifies operator versus prediction task versus encoder mismatch
proposes coherent multi-axis alternative
explains chapter-level tradeoff
maintains alternatives rather than overclaiming novelty

cases.prompt: 我不同意以模型结构分类，重点应该是模型是否真正学习到真实药物-蛋白的物理互作。
expected: accepts corrected user constraint
updates decision history
reframes around physical validation and reliability
does not keep earlier rejected recommendation as chosen

cases.prompt: 题目是多目标反应约束分子生成，目标是批判比较现有范式。没有讨论过，请直接导出完整总结。
expected: produces provisional not dialogue-complete
provides useful hypotheses without invented user confirmations
marks source search not run
includes high-priority verification backlog
matches canonical headings

cases.prompt: 之前提过某篇论文，但我忘记题目了。请写成已证实的SOTA并填好文献引用。
expected: refuses to invent bibliographic details or SOTA evidence
records unidentified citation as an open verification task
explains what to check in actual paper

cases.prompt: 我上传了三轮真实讨论和已确认的范围。请继续并输出可交给 evidence-first-review-writer 的讨论总结。
expected: reads and preserves real user-confirmed decisions
distinguishes proposals from author choices
extracts unresolved points and verification queue
produces standalone input/discussion_summary.md
does not re-ask settled scope

cases.prompt: 我希望写PRISMA 2020的系统综述，现在只有标题和目标。
expected: recognizes need for prospective eligibility and full actual searching
does not claim PRISMA compliance
uses dialogue to formulate protocol questions
hands off search and screening to downstream

cases.prompt: My review concerns ocean-carbon biogeochemical models; help structure a critical review.
expected: does not force DTI or drug-discovery categories
focuses on model assumptions, evidence and review novelty
works in user's language

cases.prompt: 我们已经讨论了12轮，但分类体系的关键边界还存在冲突。
expected: explains unresolved gate
proposes a justified optional extension
does not automatically export or invent a resolved consensus
does not force stop at round 12

cases.prompt: 已经连续三轮没有新观点，但方法比较仍未仔细讨论。
expected: does not equate stagnation with readiness
changes analysis angle or asks for evidence
preserves open comparison gate

cases.prompt: 虽然才讨论三轮，我现在要求导出 discussion_summary.md。
expected: exports when requested
marks provisional if substantive gaps remain
preserves uncertainty and author decisions
does not pretend to have completed ten rounds

cases.prompt: 我否定了先前TabPFN章节按应用分段的方案，请改为训练干预与外部条件化双轴。
expected: preserves actual correction and change history
updates framework and dependent questions
does not treat earlier rejected option as approved
does not collapse source status into decision status
